name: Ikemen Vampire◆Ijin-tachi to Koi no Yuuwaku
original_name: イケメンヴァンパイア◆偉人たちと恋の誘惑
source:
A chance encounter in the Louvre leads you into a mansion full of some of the greatest men from history! But there's a twist: they're all out for blood. Your blood. Can you survive a month living under the same roof as these deadly handsome men? Or will you give into temptation?

[from [url=https://ikemen-series.com/games/vampire/index.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在卢浮宫的一次偶遇将带你进入一座充满历史上最伟大人物的豪宅！但有一个转折点：他们都在流血。你的血。你能和这些致命的帅哥生活在同一屋檐下一个月吗？或者你会屈服于诱惑吗？

[来自[url=https://ikemen-series.com/games/vampire/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
